CREATE TABLE `erp_mercadolibre_products` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `collection_item_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `source_type` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'collected',
  `product_developer_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `product_developer_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `review_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unreviewed',
  `source_item_id` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `source_url` varchar(1500) NOT NULL,
  `main_image_url` varchar(1500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description_text` longtext,
  `price` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `currency_id` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `weight_g` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `volumetric_weight_kg` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `package_length_cm` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `package_width_cm` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `package_height_cm` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `weight_basis` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_snapshot_json` longtext,
  `added_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `sale_price_usd` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `exchange_rate_to_usd` decimal(20,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `exchange_rate_updated_at` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `category_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `category_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `management_category_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `listing_type_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `listing_type_name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `commission_rate` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `commission_amount_local` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `commission_currency_id` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `commission_amount_usd` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `shipping_fee_local` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `shipping_currency_id` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `shipping_fee_usd` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `billable_weight_g` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `shipping_api_billable_weight_g` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `shipping_weight_rule` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `net_proceeds_usd` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `profitability_updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `profitability_source` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `profitability_error` text,
  `last_publish_status` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_publish_store_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_publish_token_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_published_item_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_publish_error` text,
  `last_publish_result_json` longtext,
  `last_published_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `infringement_risk_level` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `infringement_keywords` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL,
  `infringement_reason` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `infringement_checked_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `ai_weight_price_json` longtext,
  `infringement_check_json` longtext,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uniq_erp_meli_product_item` (`source_item_id`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_product_added` (`added_at`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_product_source` (`source_type`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_product_review` (`review_status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_product_publish` (`last_publish_status`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_product_weight` (`weight_g`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_product_price` (`price`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_product_net` (`net_proceeds_usd`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_profit_refresh` (`profitability_updated_at`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_product_management_category` (`management_category_id`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_erp_meli_product_owner` (`last_publish_token_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=15878300 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
